C1254.title: Abuse of E-Commerce Return Policies Leads to Criminal Charges Against Malicious Consumers
C1254.summary: In January 2026, media reported that some bad-faith consumers exploited e-commerce return rule gaps and consumer-favoring refund review mechanisms by buying goods online, trying or using them, or directly applying for refunds while keeping the goods, repeatedly obtaining free benefits. Some such cases have led merchants to report to police and police to handle or pursue accountability; some consumers have been administratively detained, and some conduct is suspected of fraud and may lead to criminal liability.

references.title: E-Commerce Coupon Fraud Penalties Intensify? Unscrupulous Consumers Face Detention and Criminal Charges
